Priyanka Gandhi's son's exhibition photos removed

Priyanka Gandhi's son, Rehan Vadra, had photographs removed from his exhibition at Bikaner House. The exhibition reportedly featured images of protests. According to reports, 74 protest photographs were removed from the exhibition.
